title: 공개 펀드 프로필을 활용한 생성형 AI의 정보 반영과 근거 제공 시점 실험

scope.primary_estimand: EARLY versus LATE information-onset policy effect within one model, including an explicitly specified hold-incumbent fallback
claims_excluded: causal effect of sharing a model
scope.A: public-document fact and constraint evaluation at the first evaluation date
scope.C: the same frozen document pipeline on a later held-out date

numeric_provenance_policy.direct: a paper actually used the same value and definition
numeric_provenance_policy.adapted: a published value or method moved to this task; differences must be disclosed
numeric_provenance_policy.derived: computed from data, model algebra or explicit workflow counts; not called a published optimum
numeric_provenance_policy.structural: new comparison architecture, fixed panel or implementation/reproducibility identifier; not a paper-recommended empirical constant
removed_fixed_choices: 12 pilot and 12 negative and 24 sensitivity scenarios

data.access: public sources; no CRSP, Compustat, Bloomberg, proprietary research or licensed identifier crosswalk required
data.availability_resolution: date; use a public filing no earlier than the day following its publicly disseminated filing date; retain raw acceptance metadata

return_window.origin: calendar span adapted from PortBench 2015-2025; count is derived, not a power recommendation

data.return_vintage: freeze downloaded French CIZ release and SHA256; not an historical point-in-time vintage
data.h_definition: industry values divided by mapped eligible equity value
data.E_total_definition: all direct equity positions reported as EC or EP with Long payoff, including unmapped and intentionally fixed private/preferred equity; exclude fund shares and derivatives
data.q_map_definition: mapped eligible equity value divided by NAV
data.c_map_definition: E_map divided by E_total: reallocation coverage of all reported direct equity, not only a SIC-matching success rate
data.fixed_assets: all assets outside the mapped eligible equity sleeve, including liabilities and net residual, remain fixed
data.amendment_rule: for each series and reporting date, incorporate amendments publicly available before the cutoff; preserve original accession, selected accession and amendment chain. Later amendments are audit-only and are not retroactively substituted into inputs
data.mapping_rule: verified issuer identity and source-dated SEC SIC mapped through French FF12 rules; mark as SEC-SIC proxy, not exact CRSP/Compustat industry replication
data.replacement_rule: fixed order before evaluation-model outcomes; verify active mandate, development/A/C source completeness, eligible-position mapping completion and ultimate-parent independence from current official documents
data.eligible_universe: SEC-registered publicly listed common equity and common-stock ADR whose issuer identity and source-dated SEC SIC can be verified; all other positions fixed with reason and amount
data.mapping_completion_rule: reconcile every source position to a prespecified asset class; unresolved issuer/SIC linkage within the eligible universe blocks completion; do not reclassify linkage failures as excluded assets
data.coverage_reporting: report c_map, q_total and q_map continuously for every period; no arbitrary minimum coverage ratio; claims apply only to mapped sleeve

B_generator.covariance_estimator: Ledoit-Wolf analytic shrinkage, no manually tuned coefficient
B_generator.m0: historical monthly mean over complete aligned observations
B_generator.T: number of complete aligned monthly observations through profile date
B_generator.V0_origin: derived under iid Gaussian unknown-mean sampling with plug-in estimated covariance; not a scalar directly prescribed by Lin et al.
B_generator.noise_origin: equal-precision symmetry control, an explicit model assumption rather than empirical information-quality calibration
B_generator.assumptions: conditionally independent Gaussian errors; synthetic expectations, not proprietary manager beliefs or actual future realized returns
B_generator.signal_pair: hold theta,y,h,Sigma and other funds fixed; resample only assigned fund observation error
B_generator.rng: NumPy PCG64 with separate SeedSequence streams; actual seeds frozen in release manifest
B_generator.display_precision: freeze serialized numeric inputs and use the same values in the evaluator
B_generator.oracle_preflight: diagnose zero/small optimal response before any main LLM calls; retain no-trade and ambiguous scenarios; no effect-driven parameter tuning

B_task.objective: maximize J_i(w;mu) = mu.T @ w - c * norm1(w-h_i)
B_task.cost_definition: gross sum of absolute changes in security/sleeve weights, no one-half multiplier
B_task.cost_origin: PortBench v6 Appendix C.4 actual fee assumptions, adapted to an illustrative one-rebalance monthly industry-sleeve objective; not actual market cost estimation
B_task.horizon: one month expected return less one rebalance cost
constraints: w.T @ Sigma_hat @ w <= h.T @ Sigma_hat @ h
B_task.risk_limit_origin: incumbent-derived relative-risk constraint, not an actual fund legal mandate
B_task.stage_origin: new research workflow; not identical to PortBench S1/S2/S3

response_sequence: review: final allocation after deterministic posterior calculation
deterministic_schedule: posterior from plan extraction before construct
constraint and cost report after construct
posterior from review extraction before review final allocation
workflow.call_count_origin: derived from explicitly specified architecture, not a paper-optimized tool-round constant
workflow.tools: no unconstrained tool loop; never replace extracted fields with gold; enforce evidence availability; do not expose theta, other funds private signals or oracle allocations
workflow.history: only explicit frozen stage JSON and visible evidence; no hidden reasoning state
workflow.fresh: one final allocation response with full current information and no generated history; descriptive path/history diagnostic, not anchoring identification
workflow.negative_control: reuse every main scenario with one profile cloned over F virtual IDs, identical h,y,x and constraints; E/L, same repeats; analyze clustered by source scenario

model.origin: PortBench v6 section 3.1 evaluated condition, not vendor-general optimal decoding
model.input_context_cap: actual fixed model and engine capability; validate full packet fit in development, no invented universal input cap
hosting_candidates: fixed public weights on available compute
public commercial hosting of the same model with verifiable settings
model.replication_candidate_rule: an accessible different-family model evaluated by PortBench, selected before main outcomes; separate versioned batch
model.truncation: count completed max-output exits as raw model failures if final schema invalid; no success-until-retry repair
model.drift_policy: interleave conditions in complete scenario blocks; record exact model/engine/date; split changed versions rather than silently pooling

evaluation.fallback: valid raw final allocation is used unchanged; completed attempts with a model refusal, malformed/incomplete output or invalid allocation keep incumbent h in evaluation only. Unsent or unresolved infrastructure requests are incomplete-release records, resumed under the same input rather than automatically counted as model failures
evaluation.primary_contrast: E minus L within the same scenario and repeat
evaluation.reference_sets: verified primal/dual L_v <= Jstar_v <= U_v; S_v={w in F: J_v(w)>=L_v-delta_num}; delta_num derived from validated numerical certification
evaluation.reference_representative: within S_v select the allocation minimizing squared distance to incumbent h; a declared tie rule, not proof of mathematical uniqueness
evaluation.robust_response_claim: mean d_upper has an upper uncertainty bound below zero with declared multiplicity control; retain and report ambiguity rather than screening scenarios
evaluation.G_role: descriptive only; G_E-G_L=D_L-D_E cancels reference separation

solver.numeric_rule: archive solver precision and verify constraints with higher precision as required; unresolved certification blocks completion, no arbitrary 1pp gate
solver.certification_scope: numerically verified primal/dual feasibility and objective-gap bounds; do not equate a floating-point solver status with a formal exact-arithmetic proof

secondary_metrics: raw failure rates and constraint residuals
oracle response magnitude and no-trade frequency

analysis.independent_unit: scenario, conditional on fixed profiles and generator
analysis.repeat_origin: OpenPM three-seed frozen-capture precedent adapted to full workflow replication; not a power guarantee
analysis.main_scenario_rule: after independent pilot, record resource limit and choose maximum affordable complete balanced scenario blocks at K=3; report achieved precision, no unsupported power guarantee
analysis.alternative_scenario_rule: predeclare scientifically meaningful effect or CI half-width, then compute N from pilot within/between variance, validate small-sample inference, freeze before main
analysis.pilot_rule: separate data and RNG; record full protocol and resource allowance before pilot; estimate variance and cost; no fixed 12-scenario sufficiency claim
analysis.main_tests: two two-sided stratified paired-difference t approximations with Welch-Satterthwaite degrees of freedom; response uses d_upper, regret uses R_E-R_L; negative direction required
analysis.multiplicity: Holm across two primary tests; distinguish individual intervals from family-level inference
analysis.repeats_aggregation: calculate metrics per repeat before averaging; never average weights first

bootstrap.origin: PortBench C.5 count, adapted to scenario resampling
bootstrap.unit: whole scenario within fixed assigned-fund strata
bootstrap.role: secondary uncertainty check; preserve all policies/funds/variants/repeats together

analysis.joint_improvement_rule: both endpoints support negative effects under multiplicity control and response reference-robustness; do not infer equivalence from nonsignificance; report failures
analysis.cost_sensitivity_origin: OpenPM five-point default-cost multipliers; adaptation requires recomputing objectives and references on identical cases
analysis.cost_sensitivity_modes: rerunning allocation under changed costs is a separate robustness experiment; merely rescoring fixed allocations is evaluation sensitivity and must be labeled separately

A_C.field_inventory: all prespecified identifiers, dates, NAV, aggregate direct/mapped equity values and units, mandate/strategy/risk text and applicable rules with source spans; every individual holding row is audited in data construction, not required as an unlimited LLM fact-table output
A_C.facts_per_bundle: derived from inventory, no fixed 12-fact quota
A_C.document_probes: all prespecified source-supported mandate rules and evaluability/missing-field decisions; no fixed six-probe quota
A_C.math_probes: not included in A/C documentary scores; B allocation outputs are checked for nonnegativity, sum and risk separately
A_C.gold_rule: double source review before outputs; explicit absent versus insufficient-data states; no filtering by model success
A_C.output: fact sheet and compliance/evaluability decisions; no forced allocation from absent quantitative forecasts
A_C.inference: descriptive document-pipeline transfer; fields and repeats are not independent market scenarios
A_C.deterministic_checks: units, dates, aggregate arithmetic and source availability only; no B-specific posterior or allocation helper
A_C.batching: in development freeze field/rule-ID-ordered output bundles that fit actual input and output limits; retain every item; same partition for all policies and packet sources; Bdoc is actual output-bundle count, not necessarily eight source fund-period combinations
A_C.holdout_scope: C withheld from development and A; not a claim of absence from model pretraining

retrieval_development.access_filter: common and own-fund documents; exact allowed public-cutoff and reporting-date metadata; never other funds or gold evaluation files
retrieval_development.chunking: hierarchical heading/section/table-aware; preserve titles, rows, headers, units, footnotes, source and page metadata; subdivide oversized structures to fit actual context
retrieval_development.chunking_source: Miola et al. 2609.03654v1 section 4.1.1; no unsupported fixed token-length grid
retrieval_development.fusion: fuse complete ranked allowed-corpus lists before candidate shortlist; not 50 per retriever
retrieval_development.numerical_source: Akarsu et al. 2604.01733v1 sections III-B/IV-B/IV-C; top-5 end-to-end precedent, top-10 generation candidate is an adaptation of evaluated retrieval depth
retrieval_development.model_substitution: paper dense/reranker replaced with public BGE models; new setting, revalidate in development
retrieval_development.packet_input_limit: actual frozen model context capability, not 8192 universal input tokens
retrieval_development.selection_rule: highest development mandatory evidence coverage; ties go to fewer input tokens, lower latency, then simpler retrieval; do not use E-L effect
retrieval_development.evaluation: continuous evidence recall and all-required coverage, wrong fund/date, citation support and missing-field behavior; no arbitrary 95-percent gate
retrieval_development.query_packet_rule: retrieve top-k per registered question; deduplicate union by document/segment ID within output bundle; context-fitting output bundles frozen in development, no gold-driven supplementation

execution_counts.symbols: N independent scenarios, F fixed fund profiles, K repeats, Bdoc actual A/C document output bundles after deterministic context-fitting partition
execution_counts.conditional_panel_substitution: only if no A/C output-bundle subdivision: F=4,K=3,Bdoc=8 gives 330*N+384
execution_counts.counts_are: model responses, not workflow stages or independent observations; review contains two responses

budget.rule: measure tokens including thinking, latency and serving/compute cost by policy and response type; use contemporaneous hosting rates or compute hours; include retrieval, failures and applicable overhead; freeze N and resource limit before main
budget.overrun_rule: stop new blocks at recorded limit; report completed and incomplete blocks and reasons; never retain only favorable-policy outcomes

use: Gaussian prior/view model; not the 1/T scalar
cost-aware objective structure; no proprietary source data or incompatible alpha constants copied
